verses.sloka: तथा तैः कृत्तगात्रैस्तु दशग्रीवेण मार्गणैः।बभूव वसुधा तत्र प्रकीर्णा हरिभिस्तदा ।। ६.९७.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā taiḥ kṛttagātraistu daśagrīveṇa mārgaṇaiḥ।babhūva vasudhā tatra prakīrṇā haribhistadā ।। 6.97.1 ।।

translations.english: That time the battlefield was strewn with bodies of Vanaras whose limbs had been severed by the arrows of Ravana.

verses.sloka: रावणस्याप्रसह्यं तं शरसम्पातमेकतः।न शेकुः सहितुं दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ।। ६.९७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasyāprasahyaṁ taṁ śarasampātamekataḥ।na śekuḥ sahituṁ dīptaṁ pataṅgā jvalanaṁ yathā ।। 6.97.2 ।।

translations.english: Just as moths cannot bear the blazing fire, the Vanaras could not bear the glowing hail of Ravana's arrows even for an instant.
translations.hindi: उस समय महातेजस्वी और धैययुक्त लक्ष्मण जी का पराक्रम देख, सव लोग विस्मित हुए | इस युद्ध में अपना, शीघ्र वास चलाने का सामथ्यं दिखला कर, वहाँ जितने राक्षस थे, उन सब के ( लक्ष्मण जी ने ) तीन तीन बाण मारे और मेघनाद को भो मारे बाणों के ध्वस्त कर दिआ

verses.sloka: ते ऽर्दिता निशितैर्बाणैः क्रोशन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः।पावकार्चिस्समाविष्टा दह्यमाना यथा गजाः ।। ६.९७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'rditā niśitairbāṇaiḥ krośanto vipradudruvuḥ।pāvakārcissamāviṣṭā dahyamānā yathā gajāḥ ।। 6.97.3 ।।

translations.english: Tormented by sharp arrows, the scorched Vanaras fled screaming like elephants enveloped in flames.

verses.sloka: प्लवङ्गानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः।स ययौ समरे तस्मिन् विधमन् रावणः शरैः ।। ६.९७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: plavaṅgānāmanīkāni mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ।sa yayau samare tasmin vidhaman rāvaṇaḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.97.4 ।।

translations.english: At that time, driven by Ravana's arrows, the Vanaras fled from the battlefield just like huge clouds are dissipated by wind.

verses.sloka: कदनं तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम्।आससाद ततो युद्धे राघवं त्वरितस्तदा ।। ६.९७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kadanaṁ tarasā kṛtvā rākṣasendro vanaukasām।āsasāda tato yuddhe rāghavaṁ tvaritastadā ।। 6.97.5 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king, having destroyed the forest rangers, thereafter, went to Raghava hurriedly.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्तान् कपीन् दृष्ट्वा भग्नान् विद्रवतो रणे।गुल्मे सुषेणं निक्षिप्य चक्रे युद्धे ऽद्भुतं मनः ।। ६.९७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvastān kapīn dṛṣṭvā bhagnān vidravato raṇe।gulme suṣeṇaṁ nikṣipya cakre yuddhe 'dbhutaṁ manaḥ ।। 6.97.6 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the defeated and broken monkeys, Sugriva assigned Sushena for their protection and went to the battle making others wonder at his wonderful action.

verses.sloka: आत्मनः सदृशं वीरः स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम्।सुग्रीवो ऽभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः ।। ६.९७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṁ vīraḥ sa taṁ nikṣipya vānaram।sugrīvo 'bhimukhaḥ śatruṁ pratasthe pādapāyudhaḥ ।। 6.97.7 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, being a hero himself, uprooting a tree as a weapon, went towards the enemy after having assigned Sushena the responsibility of protection of Vanaras.

verses.sloka: पार्श्वतः पृष्टतश्चास्य सर्वे यूथपाधिपाः स्वयम्।अनुजह्रुर्महाशैलान् विविधांश्च महाद्रुमान् ।। ६.९७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭataścāsya sarve yūthapādhipāḥ svayam।anujahrurmahāśailān vividhāṁśca mahādrumān ।। 6.97.8 ।।

translations.english: All the leaders of the army themselves seizing hold of huge mountains and trees of several kinds followed his side.

verses.sloka: स नर्दन् युधि सुग्रीवः स्वरेण महता महान्।पातयन् विविधांश्चान्यान् जगामोत्तमराक्षसान् ।। ६.९७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa nardan yudhi sugrīvaḥ svareṇa mahatā mahān।pātayan vividhāṁścānyān jagāmottamarākṣasān ।। 6.97.9 ।।

translations.english: Great Sugriva roaring at high pitch in war destroyed several other Rakshasas and went towards the best of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: ममन्थ च महाकायो राक्षसान् वानरेश्वरः।युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव ।। ६.९७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: mamantha ca mahākāyo rākṣasān vānareśvaraḥ।yugāntasamaye vāyuḥ pravṛddhānagamāniva ।। 6.97.10 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara Lord of gigantic body, moving like the wind, tortuously destroyed the Rakshasas like a huge wind destroying the universe.

verses.sloka: राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्षं ववर्ष ह।अश्मवर्षं यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्घेषु कानने ।। ६.९७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāmanīkeṣu śailavarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha।aśmavarṣaṁ yathā meghaḥ pakṣisaṅgheṣu kānane ।। 6.97.11 ।।

translations.english: Just as clouds shower hail stones on flocks of birds in the forest, Sugriva rained showers of rocks on the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवर्षैस्तु राक्षसाः।विकीर्णशिरसः पेतुर्निकृत्ता इव पर्वताः ।। ६.९७.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kapirājavimuktaistaiḥ śailavarṣaistu rākṣasāḥ।vikīrṇaśirasaḥ peturnikṛttā iva parvatāḥ ।। 6.97.12 ।।

translations.english: Hit by the rocks rained by the Vanara king, the Rakshasas with heads broken and body mutilated had fallen like mountains.

verses.sloka: अथ सङ्क्षीयमाणेषु राक्षसेषु समन्ततः।सुग्रीवेण प्रभग्नेषु पतत्सु निनदत्सु च ।। ६.९७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha saṅkṣīyamāṇeṣu rākṣaseṣu samantataḥ।sugrīveṇa prabhagneṣu patatsu ninadatsu ca ।। 6.97.13 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter, all the Rakshasas shattered by Sugriva, tormented, fallen on the ground were shouting. Seeing that Virupaksha, himself, who is difficult to encounter, holding his bow, announcing his name, jumped from the chariot onto an elephant in a rut.

verses.sloka: विरूपाक्षः स्वकं नाम धन्वी विश्राव्य राक्षसः।रथादाप्लुत्य दुर्धर्षो गजस्कन्धमुपारुहत् ।। ६.९७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: virūpākṣaḥ svakaṁ nāma dhanvī viśrāvya rākṣasaḥ।rathādāplutya durdharṣo gajaskandhamupāruhat ।। 6.97.14 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter, all the Rakshasas shattered by Sugriva, tormented, fallen on the ground were shouting. Seeing that Virupaksha, himself, who is difficult to encounter, holding his bow, announcing his name, jumped from the chariot onto an elephant in a rut.

verses.sloka: स तं द्विरदमारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महारथः।विनदन् भीमनिर्ह्रादं वानरानभ्यधावत ।। ६.९७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ dviradamāruhya virūpākṣo mahārathaḥ।vinadan bhīmanirhrādaṁ vānarānabhyadhāvata ।। 6.97.15 ।।

translations.english: That great charioteer Virupaksha ascended the elephant, frightening like a lion, and rushed towards Vanaras roaring.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवे स शरान् घोरान् विससर्ज चमूमुखे।स्थापयामास चोद्विग्नान् राक्षसान् सम्प्रहर्षयन् ।। ६.९७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīve sa śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe।sthāpayāmāsa codvignān rākṣasān sampraharṣayan ।। 6.97.16 ।।

translations.english: Releasing arrows at the army of Vanaras and Sugriva, he (Virupaksha) pierced arrows and relieved the Rakshasas of fear and made them happy.

verses.sloka: स तु विद्धः शितैर्बाणैः कपीन्द्रस्तेन रक्षसा।चक्रोध स महाक्रोधो वधे चास्य मनो दधे ।। ६.९७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu viddhaḥ śitairbāṇaiḥ kapīndrastena rakṣasā।cakrodha sa mahākrodho vadhe cāsya mano dadhe ।। 6.97.17 ।।

translations.english: The king of Vanaras, pained by the shafts of Rakshasa, roared, and became very furious. He set in his mind to kill the Rakshasa.

verses.sloka: ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः सम्प्रधनो हरिः।अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तु महागजम् ।। ६.९७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pādapamuddhṛtya śūraḥ sampradhano hariḥ।abhipatya jaghānāsya pramukhe tu mahāgajam ।। 6.97.18 ।।

translations.english: Then springing up, the valiant Vanara uprooting a tree struck the face of the Rakshasa seated on the great elephant.

verses.sloka: स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः।अपासर्पद्धनुर्मात्रं निषसाद ननाद च ।। ६.९७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu prahārābhihataḥ sugrīveṇa mahāgajaḥ।apāsarpaddhanurmātraṁ niṣasāda nanāda ca ।। 6.97.19 ।।

translations.english: Overwhelmed by the blow of Sugriva, that great elephant retreated four cubits, distressed, and roared.

verses.sloka: गजात्तु मथितात्तूर्णमपक्रम्य स वीर्यवान्।राक्षसो ऽभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रत्युद्गम्य ततः कपिम् ।। ६.९७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: gajāttu mathitāttūrṇamapakramya sa vīryavān।rākṣaso 'bhimukhaḥ śatruṁ pratyudgamya tataḥ kapim ।। 6.97.20 ।।

translations.english: That valiant Rakshasa hero jumped down quickly from the wounded elephant, seizing hold of a shield made of bull's hide and a sword, advancing towards the enemy who stood firmly, and facing him, as if threatening him.

verses.sloka: आर्षभं चर्म खड्गं च प्रगृह्य लघुविक्रमः।भर्त्सयन्निव सुग्रीवमाससाद व्यवस्थितम् ।। ६.९७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ārṣabhaṁ carma khaḍgaṁ ca pragṛhya laghuvikramaḥ।bhartsayanniva sugrīvamāsasāda vyavasthitam ।। 6.97.21 ।।

translations.english: That valiant Rakshasa hero jumped down quickly from the wounded elephant, seizing hold of a shield made of bull's hide and a sword, advancing towards the enemy who stood firmly, and facing him, as if threatening him.

verses.sloka: स हि तस्याभिसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम्।विरूपाक्षाय चिक्षेप सुग्रीवो जलदोपमाम् ।। ६.९७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa hi tasyābhisaṅkruddhaḥ pragṛhya vipulāṁ śilām।virūpākṣāya cikṣepa sugrīvo jaladopamām ।। 6.97.22 ।।

translations.english: Holding a huge rock which was like a mass of clouds, Sugriva, who was very angry, hurled at Virupaksha.

verses.sloka: स तां शिलामापतन्तीं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः।अपक्रम्य सुविक्रान्तः खड्गेन प्राहरत्तदा ।। ६.९७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tāṁ śilāmāpatantīṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।apakramya suvikrāntaḥ khaḍgena prāharattadā ।। 6.97.23 ।।

translations.english: Then that exceedingly powerful Rakshasa leader, seeing the rock falling, struck it with a sword, jumping.

verses.sloka: तेन खड्गप्रहारेण रक्षसा बलिना हतः।मुहूर्तमभवद्वीरो विसञ्ज्ञ इव वानरः ।। ६.९७.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena khaḍgaprahāreṇa rakṣasā balinā hataḥ।muhūrtamabhavadvīro visañjña iva vānaraḥ ।। 6.97.24 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the mighty Rakshasa with a sword, the Vanara leader, a heroic one, got wounded, and became unconscious for a while.

verses.sloka: स तदा सहसोत्पत्य राक्षसस्य महाहवे।मुष्टिं संवर्त्य वेगेन पातयामास वक्षसि ।। ६.९७.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tadā sahasotpatya rākṣasasya mahāhave।muṣṭiṁ saṁvartya vegena pātayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 6.97.25 ।।

translations.english: Then in that great war, Sugriva getting up at once whirling his fist, hit (Virupaksha) him on the chest.

verses.sloka: मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतो विरूपाक्षो निशाचरः।तेन खड्गेन सङ्क्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे।कवचं पातयामास पद्भ्यामभिहतो ऽपतत् ।। ६.९७.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: muṣṭiprahārābhihato virūpākṣo niśācaraḥ।tena khaḍgena saṅkruddhaḥ sugrīvasya camūmukhe।kavacaṁ pātayāmāsa padbhyāmabhihato 'patat ।। 6.97.26 ।।

translations.english: Hit by the fist, Virupaksha became very angry and tore the armor of Sugriva by his sword in the forefront of the army. Wounded severely, Sugriva fell on his feet.
translations.hindi: किन्तु लक्ष्मण जी उसके छोड़े समस्त बाणों को बीच ही में अपने पैने बाणों से काट डालते थे । इतने में रथियों में श्रेष्ठ रथी घर्मात्मा लक्ष्मण जी ने इन्द्रजीत के सारथी का सिर एक पैने और सीघे पोरुओं बाले भल्लक बाण से काट डाला! सारथी के न रहने पर.भी घोड़े शिक्षित होने के कारण भड़के नहीं और रथ लेकर भागते हुए चक्कर काटने लगे । यह भो एक आश्चयं ही की बात थी । ऐसा होना भी उचित न जान, दृढ़पराक्रमी लक्ष्मण जी ने १ ___॥२८)

verses.sloka: स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्।तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनिस्वनम् ।। ६.९७.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa samutthāya patitaḥ kapistasya vyasarjayat।talaprahāramaśaneḥ samānaṁ bhīmanisvanam ।। 6.97.27 ।।

translations.english: Dropped down by him (Virupaksha), Sugriva, got up, and gave the Rakshasa a slap with his palm which was equal to thunderbolt that produced a terrific sound like crash.
translations.hindi: रावणपुत्र मेघनाद भो, शत्र॒घाती शत्रु द्वारा अत्यन्त घायल हो लक्ष्मण जी पर अविरल बाणवृष्टि करने लगा

verses.sloka: तलप्रहारं तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम्।नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरस्यताडयत् ।। ६.९७.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: talaprahāraṁ tadrakṣaḥ sugrīveṇa samudyatam।naipuṇyānmocayitvainaṁ muṣṭinorasyatāḍayat ।। 6.97.28 ।।

translations.english: Virupaksha, escaping the slap of Sugriva with great skill, hit him (Sugriva) on the chest with his fist.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धतरः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः।मोक्षितं चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा प्रहारं तेन रक्षसा।स ददर्शान्तरं तस्य विरूपाक्षस्य वानरः ।। ६.९७.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu saṅkruddhataraḥ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ।mokṣitaṁ cātmano dṛṣṭvā prahāraṁ tena rakṣasā।sa dadarśāntaraṁ tasya virūpākṣasya vānaraḥ ।। 6.97.29 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva, the king of the forest, grew angry and hit the Rakshasa on the forehead.

verses.sloka: ततो न्यपातयत् क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशे महत्तलम् ।। ६.९७.३० ।।दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ।। ६.९७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato nyapātayat krodhācchaṅkhadeśe mahattalam ।। 6.97.30 ।।dīptaṁ pataṅgā jvalanaṁ yathā ।। 6.97.2 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara, seeing the blow given by Virupaksha, enraged Sugriva hit him with another palm on the temporal bone by which he fell.

verses.sloka: महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ ।। ६.९७.३१ ।।।।दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा ।। ६.९७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahendrāśanikalpena talenābhihataḥ kṣitau ।। 6.97.31 ।।।।dīptaṁ pataṅgā jvalanaṁ yathā ।। 6.97.2 ।।

translations.english: Hurt by the palm which resembled Indra's weapon, blood started flowing from Virupaksha's body just like water flowed from waterfalls. Bathed in blood, vomiting blood, Virupaksha fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: उसके घोड़ों के बाण मार कर, उनको समरभूमि में भड़का दिआ । रावण के पुत्र बलवान इन्द्रजीत को यह सहन न हुआ

verses.sloka: पपात रुधिरक्लिन्नः शोणितं च समुद्वमन्।स्रोतोभ्यस्तु विरूपाक्षो जलं प्रस्रवणादिव ।। ६.९७.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: papāta rudhiraklinnaḥ śoṇitaṁ ca samudvaman।srotobhyastu virūpākṣo jalaṁ prasravaṇādiva ।। 6.97.32 ।।

translations.english: Hurt by the palm which resembled Indra's weapon, blood started flowing from Virupaksha's body just like water flowed from waterfalls. Bathed in blood, vomiting blood, Virupaksha fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: उसने असहनशील लक्ष्मण के दस बाण मार कर, उन्हें घायल किआ । उसके छोड़े वे वज के समान बिषधर सप की तरह बाण, लक्ष्मण जी सुवणं को तरह चमचमाते कवच से टकरा कर-नष्ट हो गए । तब इन्द्रजीत ने यह जानकर कि, लक्ष्मण का कवच अभेद्य है,

verses.sloka: विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात् सफेनं रुधिराप्लुतम्।ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम् ।। ६.९७.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vivṛttanayanaṁ krodhāt saphenaṁ rudhirāplutam।dadṛśuste virūpākṣaṁ virūpākṣataraṁ kṛtam ।। 6.97.33 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras witnessed Virupaksha who had misshapen eyes, turning his eyeballs in anger, foaming blood flowing from nostrils.

verses.sloka: स्फुरन्तं परिवर्तन्तं पार्श्वेन रुधिरोक्षितम्।करुणं च विनर्दन्तं ददृशुः कपयो रिपुम् ।। ६.९७.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sphurantaṁ parivartantaṁ pārśvena rudhirokṣitam।karuṇaṁ ca vinardantaṁ dadṛśuḥ kapayo ripum ।। 6.97.34 ।।

translations.english: Virupaksha rolled, by changing sides bathed in blood, causing sorrow and compassion to Vanaras who witnessed.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रजीत ने सुन्दर फोंक से युक्त तीन बाण लक्ष्मण जी के माथे में मारे | इस प्रकार इन्द्रजीत ने क्रुद्ध हो, शीघ्र बाण चलाने का अपना सामथ्य प्रकट किआ

verses.sloka: तथा तु तौ संयति सम्प्रयुक्तौ तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम्।बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुः सुभीमं महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नवेलौ ।। ६.९७.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā tu tau saṁyati samprayuktau tarasvinau vānararākṣasānām।balārṇavau sasvanatuḥ subhīmaṁ mahārṇavau dvāviva bhinnavelau ।। 6.97.35 ।।

translations.english: Thus, both close to each other, both redoubtable armies, of Vanaras and Rakshasas, both powerful and terrific, both mighty, roared as if the great ocean had burst.

verses.sloka: विनाशितं प्रेक्ष्य विरूपनेत्रं महाबलं तं हरिपार्थिवेन।बलं समस्तं कपिराक्षसानामुन्मत्तगङ्गाप्रतिमं बभूव ।। ६.९७.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vināśitaṁ prekṣya virūpanetraṁ mahābalaṁ taṁ haripārthivena।balaṁ samastaṁ kapirākṣasānāmunmattagaṅgāpratimaṁ babhūva ।। 6.97.36 ।।

translations.english: Beholding that mighty warrior of hideous eyes destroyed by the king of the monkeys, the whole host of monkeys and rakshasas surged like the Ganga in flood.
translations.hindi: उस महायुद्ध में इन्द्रजीत द्वारा उन बाणों से घायल हो, लक्ष्मण जी ने भी उसके पांच बाण मार कर, उसको घायल कर दिआ

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptanavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 97 ।।

translations.hindi: ये बाण, सुन्दर कुण्डलों से शोभित इन्द्रजीत के मुखमण्डल में लगे । इस प्रकार भयङ्कर विक्रमकारी महाबलवान एवं विशाल घनुषधारी वीर लक्ष्मण ओर इन्द्रजीत, बड़े पैने पैने बाणो से एक दूसरे. को घायल करने लगे । इससे लक्ष्मण और इन्द्रजीत दोनों ही लोहू से नहा गये
